relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: Arachidonic acid (AA), NF-kB, NLRP3 inflammasome, and nitric oxide pathways along with P2X7 receptor and ion channel transient receptor potential (TRP) vanilloid are some of the recently explored targets for modulation of pain and inflammation in SCI.

key_findings: Review of polyphenols as natural analgesic and anti-inflammatory candidates in SCI, targeting NF-kB, NLRP3, P2X7 and TRPV pathways.
No clinical studies yet; evidence is preclinical.
